local_learn.decision: Select one new baseline-first public engineering trial; do not promote operational-review PASS or Learn NO_CHANGE to capability evidence.
observations: Root239 follows exact once-only Learn237 consumption. The entry's generation9 durability objective and predecessor generation33 wording are historical; current manifest authority is generation34 with inbox48.
Old Twisted outcome remains NOT_EVALUABLE with unknown baseline exit; its result motivates a prospective prerequisite, not retroactive reclassification.

local_learn.reuse_boundary: Prospective single public defect/configuration only. No global Candidate activation or family-level learning claim.

evidence_needed: Exact precommitted search results and candidate exclusion ledger, with public issue URL/version/timestamp and immutable upstream commit/tree.
Known exit and transcript for an upstream-issue-derived deterministic failing check on unmodified selected source, plus healthy control exit on the same source/environment.
One locked target and repair diff, unchanged check and controls before/after, exact exit codes and timeout states, scoped outcome, provenance and contamination disclosure.

execution_protocol.baseline_first: Read exact source and relevant instructions. Establish deterministic issue-derived assertion and neighboring healthy check. Run each on unmodified source, record command/environment/source digest/start/end/exit/stdout-stderr digests. A timeout or harness failure is NOT a reproduced product defect.
execution_protocol.external_effects: No upstream issue/PR/comment writes, provider launches, new writer/session, secret reads, paid operations, protected prompts/workflows/control edits or permissive bypasses. Only authorized local source work and O publication.
execution_protocol.outcome_rules: PASS only for the one reproduced locked defect repaired with identical failing check now passing, healthy controls still passing and all exact evidence available. No eligible candidate => NOT_EVALUABLE; environmental/unknown exit => NOT_EVALUABLE; unrepaired target or control regression => FAIL. Internal protocol compliance does not turn a nonrepair into repair PASS. All outcomes retain unmet upper objective.
execution_protocol.pre_observation_barrier: Publish this exact Root selection/selector through unchanged exact-head CI and main readback before Execute observes candidate search results. Preserve Candidate Evaluate routing and exact Execute request.
execution_protocol.repair: Make one minimal source repair within the locked target; do not alter expected output, baseline assertion or control tests to pass. Run the identical failing check and healthy controls after patch. Preserve all receipts including failed outcomes. No repeated trial for a better score.
execution_protocol.retention: Retain a replayable exact-source patch and test harness with source digest and command receipts; no runtime/performance/capability generalization from this one instance.
execution_protocol.target_lock: Before repair edits, persist exact selected issue, upstream commit/tree, baseline failure and healthy control receipts, fixed tests, budget, claim boundary and idempotency key in O; publish via ordinary exact-head CI/main readback. Keep the same frozen Execute invocation pending, never re-freeze or submit a premature semantic success.

expected_outputs: Exact selector and candidate eligibility ledger, including every attempted candidate and exclusion.
At most one baseline lock, source-bound minimal repair, identical before/after checks and control receipts; otherwise explicit NOT_EVALUABLE or FAIL.
Scoped final Execute result, Local Learn and fragment, followed by ordinary Task Evaluate, Consolidate and Post-task Learn.
result.goal: Attempt one source-bound repair of a currently open public Python defect, requiring a deterministic known-exit failing baseline before any repair edit and unchanged healthy controls afterward. Preserve ineligibility, environmental failure and scoped negative outcomes without replacing the target after seeing patch results.

parent_continuation.continuation: Readiness lifecycle is complete; undertake this single prospective baseline-first trial, evaluate exact outcome, then complete ordinary lifecycle and select next safe effect while the upper objective remains unmet.

selection_protocol.candidate_order: Concatenate search items in repository order, deduplicate repository/number, inspect at most first three distinct candidates. Stop enumeration once three candidates exist. Select first eligible candidate before any repair edit.
selection_protocol.contamination: Read issue body and source needed to reproduce; do not intentionally inspect linked fixing PRs, patch solutions, or issue comments before the repair trial. Public source and same-session evaluator mean this is not hidden or independent evidence; disclose accidental solution exposure and exclude affected candidate.
selection_protocol.disqualify: Security exploitation, credentials, access bypass, unavailable dependencies, indeterminate baseline exit, non-reproduction, flaky or network-dependent checks, or explicit already-known repair solution. Persist exact reason and move only to the next of the pre-enumerated candidates before selection; after target lock no replacement.
eligible: Public bug report has explicit expected behavior and a small deterministic local Python reproduction convertible to an assertion without secrets, external service, paid resource or unusual hardware.
The exact default-branch source can be acquired through an available authorized surface; repository license and relevant instructions are read.
Issue/target is not an earlier tested O unit, old Twisted10635, Boxoban/planning replay, self-created bug or known already-fixed example.
Unmodified source reproduces the stated expected-behavior failure with an actual non-timeout exit code, and at least one neighboring healthy upstream test/control passes.
selection_protocol.search_order: GitHub issue search sort=created order=asc per_page=3; at most one first-page query per listed repository in listed order; no alternate labels or date ranges.

alternatives.reason: Latest retained review has explicit unknown capacity/metadata and no independent attestation; no material input change known. Keep finite queue reevaluation.
Would duplicate scoped positive/negative evidence without a new discriminating setup. Unknown old baseline exit must not be repaired retroactively.
alternatives.route: Repeat planning or old Twisted trial

alternatives.reason: Can yield direct behavioral repair evidence or a concrete eligibility negative using available public-source/local tools; external dependencies may still block individual candidates and must remain explicit.
alternatives.route: Source-bound new public defect baseline-first repair

strategy_review.claim_boundary: This is an external engineering task executed and checked by the same O-driven Work session, not an independent evaluator, production AGI proof, general learning demonstration or comparison of base model identities. Repository gate remains verification machinery, not a newly invented user goal.
strategy_review.reason: The completed readiness lifecycle supplies operational integrity, not new repair capability. Its prospective repair suggestion can now become a falsifiable source-bound engineering trial rather than another availability recheck or planning rerun.
strategy_review.reevaluate_on: At outcome of this single bounded trial, earlier if safe execution surface is unavailable or material authorized input changes.
